$comment: Configuration for the Azure tags -> TopDesk CMDB sync. Edit these values for your tenant; do not put secrets here.

resourceTypeNotes.Microsoft.Web/sites: Function Apps are ARM type Microsoft.Web/sites with kind 'functionapp'. The reader module filters on kind for this type.

topdeskCiLookup.description: Field used to find the matching TopDesk CI for an Azure resource. 'name' matches the Azure resource name against the TopDesk CI's 'name' field. Change to another CI field/value (e.g. an external/reference id) if your TopDesk tenant uses a different key.

scope.description: Restrict which resources are read. Leave resourceGroups empty to scan the whole subscription set in AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID.
